checks.evidence: Generated tests use generic AAL1 authentication and an attempted upgrade, and never sign in through e-Devlet with a below-AAL2 ID token. They also do not check for limited mode with no personal data shown.
No test covers back-office KKS sign-in with an acr below AAL3. No test checks that no back-office session is opened.

Test 'Session AAL can be lower than authentication event AAL' only checks that the session AAL is AAL1 after AAL2 authentication. It never uses a function requiring a lower assurance level to confirm it is available.

invented: An error or warning is logged indicating that the session AAL cannot exceed the authentication event AAL
A configuration option to explicitly assign a lower AAL to a session at creation
An API or mechanism to set or upgrade the session AAL after creation
